"House of LSD is new adult entertainment studio started by sisters, Luna, Skye and Devi (hence the name). With a new business means new people, coming together in more ways than one! Watch as friendships and relationships take form between the colorful cast and crew, whether they wanted it or not..Rated R for mature humor and occasional nudity." - Artist

Here's House of LSD. A webcomic created by J3T (real name being Jodi Tong) that started in 2009 and stop in 2016.
This is a reboot of an older comic of the same name.

Here's a link to the old original comic:
https://e-hentai.org/g/4138937/c120447847

If anyone's interested, here is J3T old FAQs of House of LSD back when J3T was working on rebooting the old version of the comic to what you see now:
